info.description: A training class (e.g. Muay Thai, CrossFit, Yoga). Each class has a thumbnail, description, intensity level, and links to schedule slots.

content-manager.label: URL Slug
content-manager.description: URL path segment, auto-generated from the title. E.g. "our-classes" → /our-classes.

content-manager.label: Tagline
content-manager.description: Short punchy line shown beneath the title (one sentence max).

content-manager.label: Description
content-manager.description: Detailed description with rich text formatting.

content-manager.label: Duration (minutes)
content-manager.description: Class length in minutes, e.g. 60 for a one-hour class.

content-manager.label: Intensity Level
content-manager.description: How physically demanding this class is: Low, Medium, High, or Extreme.

content-manager.label: Experience Level
content-manager.description: Who this class suits: Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced, or All levels.

content-manager.label: Discipline
content-manager.description: The martial art or training style this class belongs to.

content-manager.label: Card Image
content-manager.description: Main image shown on the class card and as the video poster. Use a tall/portrait or square photo (min 1200px).

content-manager.label: Card Hover Video
content-manager.description: Short muted loop (5-10s, under 3 MB, MP4/WebM). Plays when someone hovers the class card.

content-manager.label: Class Video
content-manager.description: Full video shown on the class page. Visitors press play themselves (sound on).

content-manager.label: Gallery (photos & videos)
content-manager.description: Photos and clips for this class. Shown as a clickable gallery on the class page (opens in a lightbox). Add as many as you like; order = display order.

content-manager.label: Free Class?
content-manager.description: Tick if this class is free and does not require a membership or pass.

content-manager.label: Sort Order
content-manager.description: Lower numbers appear first in listings. Items with the same number are sorted alphabetically.

content-manager.label: SEO Settings
content-manager.description: Search engine optimisation settings for this page.
